question: Who among the following Chola kings built the Rajarajeshwara temple of Tanjore?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rajaraja Chola __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajarajeshwara temple** is popularly known as **Brihadeshwara temple **and is locally known as **Thanjai Periya Kovil.**
 
• It was **built in Dravidian style** and **dedicated to Shiva **by Rajaraja around **1009 AD**.
 
• It is located on the **south bank of the Cauvery river** in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu.
 
• **UNESCO** designated the Brihadeshwara temple a **World Heritage Site (WHS) in 1987**.
 
• It is one of the** "Great Living Chola Temples"** along with Gangaikonda Cholapuram and Airawatesvara temples.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Rajaraja Chola (985-1014AD)**

 
• During his reign, the Chola empire expanded from **Kalinga in the north to Srilanka in the South.**
 
• He fought** battles with the Chalukyas** in the north and **the Pandyas** in the south.
 
• He also helped in the construction of a **Buddhist monastery in Nagapattinam.**
 
• He was succeeded by his son** Rajendra Chola I in 1014 AD.​**
 
• **​Rajendra III **was the last ruler of the Chola dynasty.

 **Rajadhiraja Chola I (1044-1054AD)**

 
• Destroyed** the Chalukyan city Kalyani **and built Jaystambh at Yadgir.
 
• Also known as **Jayam Konda.**

**​ Vikram Chola (1120-1133AD)**

 
• He succeeded** Kulottunga I.**
 
• He **recovered the Gangavadi area from Hoyasalas.**
